name: Wrist Roller
steps: Attach the plate securely to the wrist roller cord and stand with the plate clear of your feet.
Hold the roller horizontally in an overhand grip with your elbows slightly bent and shoulders relaxed.
Turn the roller hand over hand so the cord wraps evenly and raises the plate.
Reverse the turns to lower the plate under control until it rests on the floor.
tips: Keep your wrists moving while your elbows stay relatively still.
Keep tension on the cord during the descent so the plate cannot drop.
